mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift to risk assets.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.2%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95 (INDPRO) indicates manufacturing supply constraints that reduce corporate profit growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days during supply-constrained regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL yoy change > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 130,000 thousand supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 130,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) above 96 indicates expanding manufacturing output that supports economic growth and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 96, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signal a severe demand shock that triggers equity market corrections, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and GDPC1 decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
